peekReplies: Sabr. Sabr ka phal 12 baje milega.

Itni jaldi? Birthday girl ko patience bhi gift mein chahiye kya?

Gadha main hoon — par itna bhi nahi ki tumhe pehle kholne doon.
Okay, you're stubborn. Mujhe pata tha.
{count} baar try kar chuki ho. Main gin raha hoon.

littleLines.line: Abhi time hai. Par main abhi se excited hoon.
Aaj raat. Bas itna yaad rakhna.
Kuch ghante aur. Phone charge kar lo.
Ek ghanta bhi nahi bacha. Main bhi yahin hoon, ghadi dekh raha hoon.
Earphones laga lo. Sound on. Trust me.
Five minutes. Paani pee lo, wapas aao, don't blink.
Ek minute. Ab phone mat rakhna.

reasons.title: You once asked why I love you. I made a list. It got out of hand.
items: You forgive me. Har baar. Even when I haven't earned it yet.
You stay. Every single time I needed someone, it was you.
You call me "Gadha" — and somehow it is the sweetest thing anyone calls me.
On 12 April 2022 you said yes. I have been the lucky one every day since.
Red looks like it was invented for you.
You would pick rice over almost anything. I would pick you over everything.
You were my best friend first. You still are.
You make an ordinary day feel like an occasion.
You believe in me on the days I don't.
Tumhari hansi. It fixes things nothing else can.
You know all of me — the good and the gadha — and you are still here.
Because your name means the wick of a lamp, and you really are the light in my life.
reasons.afterLast: Yeh wala hissa mazaak nahi hai.

letter.tapFallback: Ya bas ek baar tap karo.
paragraphs:
Tumhare naam ka matlab pata hai? *Diye ki baati* — the little wick that holds the flame.
I didn't know that when I met you. But I think I felt it.
Because that is what you do. You never make noise about it — you just make things brighter.
Every time I got it wrong, you forgave me. Not once, not twice — har baar. And every time I needed someone, I never had to look far. You were already there.
You didn't have to. You did. I never told you how much that meant. I am telling you now.
I am not good at saying big things out loud. So I made this instead — every star, every page, every silly button — just to say one small, true thing:

Happy birthday, Vartu. Stay exactly who you are.
Main yahin hoon — aaj, kal, aur har 28 November.
